purpose: Independent confirmation of validation-selected Burgers checkpoints and a conservative Euler trust-region blend after v1 failure analysis.

development_boundary.burgers_change: Save the minimum internal-validation checkpoint, use two validation cases per viscosity, and cover the declared amplitude envelope during training.
development_boundary.euler_change: Multiply the learned conservative jump blend by 0.75; this value was selected on the v1 development results and is therefore tested only on new f11-f20 cases.

numeric_requirements.dtype: torch.float64 throughout training, finite-volume solving, inference, and metrics
numeric_requirements.checkpoint_audit: all floating model-state tensors must be torch.float64

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum aggregate validation MSE sampled every 100 iterations

blind_benchmark.reference: the v1-audited adaptive WENO policy: 4096 cells for nu <= 0.001, 2048 for nu = 0.003, 1024 for nu = 0.01
blind_benchmark.novelty: No listed amplitude appears in the v1 blind benchmark or model training cases.

burgers.primary: per-seed geometric mean of fixed-MC normalized-L2 divided by sensor-gated DKAN normalized-L2 over 60 pairs

euler.checkpoints: Reuse the ten v1 float64 checkpoints; f11-f20 were generated and frozen only after the v1 audit.

blind_case_generation.method: six-dimensional Latin hypercube with ten strata, independent permutations and uniform jitter in [0.15, 0.85] of each stratum

euler.primary: per-seed geometric mean of fixed conservative-MC primitive-composite-L2 divided by trust-region DKAN value over 30 pairs

cross_equation_gate.per_seed_gain: sqrt(Burgers seed gain * Euler seed gain) by seed index

claim_boundary: Even if v2 passes, the result is a supervised finite-volume/DKAN reconstruction hybrid, not a successful data-free PINN, and it does not establish the 2D claim.

execution_outcome.stopping_rule: Stopped after the first Burgers seed because one failed pair is sufficient to falsify the frozen every-pair gate.
